description: This PHP source file defines the `LoggerSubscriber` class within the OrangeHRM project, which subscribes to kernel exception events and logs error details when exceptions occur.

classes.name: LoggerSubscriber
classes.description: A class that subscribes to Symfony kernel exception events and logs exception messages and traces for the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this subscriber is interested in; in this case, the exception event with high priority.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles the exception event by retrieving the exception details and logging the message and stack trace.
